title: Smart India Hackathon 2027
summary: The Government of India's national hackathon on problem statements from ministries, PSUs and industry, with a 36-hour grand finale at nodal centres.
location: Internal hackathon + nodal centres across India
eligibility: Students at Indian institutions; teams of exactly six from the same institution with at least one woman. Registration goes through the college SPOC.

prize.description: ₹1,00,000 for the winning team of each problem statement (₹75,000 and ₹50,000 for runners-up in some categories).

notes: SIH 2026 launched on 21 August 2026, with its grand finale in December 2026. Expect the 2027 cycle around August 2027.
Confirm prize amounts for the 2027 problem-statement categories on the portal.
